scenarios.title: A static page at the loopback origin renders WebGL2 under SwiftShader
scenarios.asserts: heading and probe canvas visible; a WebGL2 clear reads back rgba(0, 128, 255, 255)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M0. Harness precondition of V02: the e2e tier can render WebGL2 without a GPU (e2e/specs/harness/webgl-and-firewall.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: A request to a host outside the allowlist is aborted and reported
scenarios.asserts: fetch of a Firestore URL fails in the page; the firewall fixture records the URL and the console guard the blocked load
scenarios.notes: Milestone M0. Proves the firewall fixture (e2e/support/network.ts) that every later spec relies on to keep real Mapbox and Google off the network; since M1 Mapbox hosts are answered by the mock APIs, so the probe uses Firestore, which nothing may reach.

scenarios.title: Mapbox GL from the mock APIs draws a mapbox:// tileset and an XYZ layer in the middle slot
scenarios.asserts: pixel probes read the basemap background, then each layer's solid colour; both rasters in the middle slot; 1 map created, 1 map.load event; style, TileJSON, glyphs and tiles answered 200
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. The mock APIs (e2e/mock-apis/) behind Mapbox GL JS 3.32.0, driven directly on a spec-made page (e2e/specs/harness/mock-apis.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: A Mapbox path the mock does not implement answers 404 and is recorded
scenarios.asserts: the page's fetch gets 404; GET /__calls lists the path with status 404; the console guard records the failed load
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. An API the engine starts to use without a mock fails loudly instead of reaching the network.

scenarios.title: Manifest loads into map, timeline and photo markers
scenarios.asserts: manifest -> map, timeline and photo markers rendered

scenarios.title: Manifest 404 shows a localized error with Retry
scenarios.asserts: manifest 404 -> localized error message and a Retry button

scenarios.title: Schema-invalid manifest shows an error card
scenarios.asserts: zod-invalid manifest -> error card, no blank map

scenarios.title: Slow Storage shows a skeleton, then a timeout message
scenarios.asserts: slow Storage -> skeleton with a visible loading indicator named viewer.loading, then a localized timeout message

scenarios.title: A manifest that needs a newer engine names the version it needs
scenarios.asserts: city.engine.minVersion newer than ENGINE_VERSION -> localized error with that version, no blank map
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. Contract: docs/ENGINE_API.md -> Errors and validation (checkManifestCompat).

scenarios.title: Without JavaScript the page explains that the map needs it
scenarios.asserts: with JavaScript off the page title is the city name, the Romanian and English no-script notes are visible and the mount point stays empty
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. The generated site page (scripts/site/src/page.ts), e2e/specs/viewer/no-javascript.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A failed load shows a Material 3 error card with a filled tonal Retry
scenarios.asserts: manifest 404 -> the card is painted in the theme error container with on-error-container text; Retry is a filled tonal button (secondary container); axe WCAG 2.2 AA passes
scenarios.notes: M1 follow-up, delivered with M2 (the viewer fixes of the M1 reviews, docs/research/M0-handoff.md §10o). packages/ui/src/viewer/hcm-error-card.ts; unit test happyPath_anM3ErrorContainerWithAFilledTonalRetry.

scenarios.title: No error card a visitor meets speaks jargon
scenarios.asserts: manifest 404, a manifest that needs a newer engine and no WebGL -> in RO and EN the card names no manifest, WebGL, JSON, schema, engine or tiles; it says what to do or what still works
scenarios.notes: M1 follow-up, delivered with M2 (the viewer fixes of the M1 reviews, docs/research/M0-handoff.md §10o). Copy in packages/shared/src/i18n/ro.ts and en.ts (keys unchanged); unit test badPath_noVisitorErrorSpeaksJargonInEitherLanguage; the no-WebGL card in e2e/specs/viewer/no-webgl.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: WebGL2 renders the map
scenarios.asserts: WebGL2 available -> map rendered

scenarios.title: Without WebGL a fallback card appears and the photo list still works
scenarios.asserts: --disable-3d-apis -> fallback card; photo list still usable, its last row scrolls clear of the menu button

scenarios.title: Toggling a layer shows and hides it with its attribution
scenarios.asserts: layer on/off verified by pixel probe; attribution shown

scenarios.title: A tileset whose tiles fail names the layer in a toast and the map keeps working
scenarios.asserts: tiles answering 503 (an outage) -> a toast names the layer; another layer still draws (pixel probe). A 404 tile means no imagery there to Mapbox GL and is never reported

scenarios.title: Markup in a layer's attribution is shown as text, never rendered
scenarios.asserts: a layer whose attribution holds an https anchor tag, an ampersand and a bold tag -> the map's attribution control and the Layers panel show the characters as text; no link or element is created from them
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. Mapbox GL parses a source attribution as HTML (keeping links); the engine escapes it (packages/engine/src/map/rasters.ts attributionText).

scenarios.title: A visible historical layer turns the basemap's 3D buildings off
scenarios.asserts: the Standard style's show3dObjects configuration is false while a historical layer is visible and true again once it is hidden
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. engine-core CR-11: packages/engine/src/map/basemap.ts (unit tests in packages/engine/test/map/).

scenarios.title: A basemap style without the basemap import is never reconfigured
scenarios.asserts: toggling a layer on a style without the basemap import leaves its configuration alone and logs no console error

scenarios.title: Selecting a year shows its layer and filters photos
scenarios.asserts: year selection shows the layer; photo year filter in sync

scenarios.title: A year without a layer is disabled or snaps to the nearest
scenarios.asserts: year without a layer -> stop disabled or snaps to the nearest year

scenarios.title: Photos near the selected year are one tap away
scenarios.asserts: at a stop with photos within 10 years the chip 'Fotografii din jurul anului …' shows and opens the list of those photos; at 'today' no chip shows
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. engine-ui CR-20: packages/ui/src/viewer/viewer-render.ts; the window is PHOTO_YEAR_WINDOW of @hcm/shared.

scenarios.title: A city without historical layers says they are coming instead of showing a timeline
scenarios.asserts: no timeline slider; the note 'Straturile istorice vin în curând' (EN 'Historical layers coming soon') is visible above the map chrome, clear of the menu button
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. Integrator: packages/ui/src/viewer/viewer-render.ts (unit tests in packages/ui/test/viewer/hcm-map-viewer.test.ts); Bucharest has no layers until M3.

scenarios.title: The no-layers note never covers the menu button or the Mapbox logo
scenarios.asserts: at 320 px and on a compact-height landscape phone the note wraps or shrinks; the menu button, the Mapbox logo and the attribution stay fully visible and clickable

scenarios.title: Opacity slider changes the layer opacity
scenarios.asserts: opacity 0 versus 1 by pixel probe; slider ARIA value

scenarios.title: An out-of-range opacity in the URL hash is clamped
scenarios.asserts: out-of-range hash value -> clamped

scenarios.title: Swipe compare creates a second map lazily and reveals both sides
scenarios.asserts: lazy second map (count 2); slider reveals left versus right

scenarios.title: On compact width compare is unavailable and a toggle is offered
scenarios.asserts: compact width -> compare unavailable, toggle instead

scenarios.title: Leaving compare destroys the second map
scenarios.asserts: exit -> second map destroyed (count 1)

scenarios.title: Photo clusters expand and open the photo sheet
scenarios.asserts: clusters expand on zoom; click -> bottom sheet (compact) or side sheet (medium and up); view cones at high zoom

scenarios.title: A missing photo image shows a placeholder with alt text
scenarios.asserts: image 404 -> placeholder and alt text

scenarios.title: A photo without a bearing gets a plain marker and no cone
scenarios.asserts: photo without bearing -> unrotated marker, no view cone at high zoom, sheet still opens
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. 11 of the migrated Bucharest photos have no cone (seed/bucharest/manifest.static.json).

scenarios.title: A photo's rights holder is credited under its licence
scenarios.asserts: the photo sheet shows '© <holder>' after the licence line
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. Integrator (engine-ui CR-18): packages/ui/src/viewer/hcm-photo-sheet.ts, i18n photo.rightsHolder.

scenarios.title: A photo without a rights holder shows no © line
scenarios.asserts: the sheet shows the licence and no '©' line, never an empty or placeholder credit

scenarios.title: The photo list shows each date as 14 px supporting text under a 16 px title
scenarios.asserts: photo list from the menu -> every date line is M3 body-medium (14 px on a 20 px line), every title body-large (16 px), none cut
scenarios.notes: M1 follow-up, delivered with M2 (the viewer fixes of the M1 reviews, docs/research/M0-handoff.md §10o).

scenarios.title: A long or a missing date wraps in the same supporting text and is never cut
scenarios.asserts: at 320 px a 90-character date text wraps at 14 px without being cut; the photos without a date say "An necunoscut" or "Year unknown" at 14 px
scenarios.notes: M1 follow-up, delivered with M2 (the viewer fixes of the M1 reviews, docs/research/M0-handoff.md §10o).

scenarios.title: Lightbox opens, zooms, navigates and returns focus
scenarios.asserts: open, pinch-zoom (touch), arrow keys, Esc returns focus

scenarios.title: A broken full image shows an error state and close still works
scenarios.asserts: broken full image -> error state; close still works

scenarios.title: Reaching the last photo with the Next button keeps the focus in the lightbox
scenarios.asserts: Next pressed from the keyboard onto the last photo -> Next is disabled, the lightbox has the focus, Shift+Tab and Tab wrap inside it, Esc closes it and the focus returns to the opener
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. A focused button that becomes disabled drops the focus to the page (Chromium focus fixup).

scenarios.title: On a landscape phone the lightbox fits the whole photo on an opaque scrim
scenarios.asserts: 915 x 412: the loaded full image lies inside the lightbox stage (not cropped); the scrim beside it is black, so the photo sheet and the menu do not show through
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. UX review: the stage's auto row let the image overflow and crop; the 92 % scrim let the viewer show through (packages/ui/src/viewer/lightbox-styles.ts; unit test in packages/ui/test/viewer/hcm-lightbox.test.ts).

scenarios.title: Deep links restore state and Share copies the URL
scenarios.asserts: #photo= and #layers=&view= restore state; Share copies the URL

scenarios.title: An unknown photo id in the hash shows a toast
scenarios.asserts: unknown photo id -> toast

scenarios.title: A malformed hash falls back to defaults
scenarios.asserts: malformed hash -> defaults

scenarios.title: A link from the old site opens the same view
scenarios.asserts: #15.5/44.4271/26.0853/90/!a3!p2 -> camera at that view; the hash is rewritten in the v1 form; layer codes ignored
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. Contract: docs/ENGINE_API.md -> URL hash v1 (legacy hash).

scenarios.title: A refused clipboard without Web Share says the link could not be copied
scenarios.asserts: the toast share.failed shows; the URL, the view and the open sheet are unchanged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. engine-ui CR-20: packages/ui/src/viewer/services.ts, viewer-actions.ts.

scenarios.title: Granted geolocation inside the city moves the camera
scenarios.asserts: permission granted, in bounds -> camera moves

scenarios.title: Denied geolocation shows a message
scenarios.asserts: permission denied -> message

scenarios.title: A location outside the city shows a message
scenarios.asserts: out of city bounds -> message

scenarios.title: Romanian by default; English persists after reload
scenarios.asserts: RO by default; switch to EN persists after reload; html lang; localized dates

scenarios.title: An unsupported language falls back to Romanian
scenarios.asserts: ?lang=fr -> RO

scenarios.title: A missing English key falls back to Romanian
scenarios.asserts: English viewer: a photo title without its English text shows the Romanian one; no raw message key appears on the page (a missing catalogue key is a compile error and an i18n gate failure)

scenarios.title: System dark theme, manual toggle and seed colour apply
scenarios.asserts: system dark; manual toggle persists; seed colour applied (axe contrast)

scenarios.title: An invalid seed colour falls back to the default palette
scenarios.asserts: a theme seed that is not a hex colour is refused (error card naming city.theme.seedColor and validation.format) and the card keeps the engine palette, readable (axe colour contrast)

scenarios.title: A high-contrast preference switches to the high-contrast scheme
scenarios.asserts: prefers-contrast: more -> the high-contrast tokens of the city theme; text contrast at least 7:1 (axe)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. ui-kit: applyTheme follows prefers-contrast in every mode (packages/ui/src/theme/apply.ts; unit tests in packages/ui/test/theme/apply.test.ts).

scenarios.title: Blocked font files leave readable text and no icon names on screen
scenarios.asserts: the self-hosted font requests fail -> text in the fallback stack, no icon ligature shown as a word, every control keeps its accessible name
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. ui-kit: installFonts/loadIconFont (packages/ui/src/fonts/font-faces.ts) and hcm-icon's clipped 1 em box; no Google Fonts host is ever requested (V16).

scenarios.title: About and credits render from the manifest in RO and EN
scenarios.asserts: rendered from the manifest, RO and EN

scenarios.title: Empty credits hide the credits section
scenarios.asserts: empty credits -> section hidden

scenarios.title: Markup in About text is shown as text, never rendered
scenarios.asserts: About with an image tag carrying an onerror handler and a bold marker -> the tag is visible text, no element is created; bold renders; only https links are links
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. Markdown subset: packages/shared/src/text/markdown.ts; a non-https link fails manifest validation.

scenarios.title: Keyboard order reaches timeline, layers and photos with visible focus
scenarios.asserts: skip link -> timeline -> layers -> photos; focus visible

scenarios.title: Forced colours stay readable
scenarios.asserts: forced-colors active -> every text has 4.5:1 against the colours actually painted, every kit control keeps an edge, axe (WCAG 2.2 AA without the author-colour rules) passes on the map, the Layers panel, the menu and About

scenarios.title: Reduced motion disables fly animations
scenarios.asserts: reduced motion -> show my location jumps to the visitor (at most 2 move events, no fly animation); the loading skeleton does not shimmer

scenarios.title: Enter on the focused map opens the photo under its centre
scenarios.asserts: with the map focused and a photo marker at its centre, Enter or Space opens that photo's sheet

scenarios.title: Enter on the focused map with nothing at its centre does nothing
scenarios.asserts: no sheet opens and focus stays on the map

scenarios.title: Shift+Tab right after a modal sheet opens stays inside the sheet
scenarios.asserts: photo opened from the focused map below 840 px -> the modal sheet takes the focus; Shift+Tab moves to its last control, never to the page behind; Esc closes it and the map has the focus again
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. trapTab (packages/ui/src/components/focus.ts) treats the focused container as the start of the trap.

scenarios.title: A toast is announced by a live region that exists before its text
scenarios.asserts: a toast appears (link copied, unknown photo, location refused) -> its polite status region is in the page empty, then holds the message only (not the Close label), so screen readers announce it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. The delay is unit-tested (packages/ui/test/components/snackbar.test.ts); the e2e needs a recorder of live-region changes inside shadow roots.

scenarios.title: On an extra-large screen the focused skip link shows over the map, clear of the Layers heading
scenarios.asserts: at 1920 x 1080 the first Tab shows the skip link over the map pane; the docked Layers heading stays uncovered (on top); Enter moves the focus to the timeline
scenarios.notes: M1 follow-up, delivered with M2 (the viewer fixes of the M1 reviews, docs/research/M0-handoff.md §10o).

scenarios.title: With the Layers and a photo docked, the focused skip link covers neither heading
scenarios.asserts: extra-large with a photo open (three panes) -> the focused skip link overlaps neither pane; the Layers and the photo headings stay on top
scenarios.notes: M1 follow-up, delivered with M2 (the viewer fixes of the M1 reviews, docs/research/M0-handoff.md §10o).

scenarios.title: No overflow or overlap at every viewport
scenarios.asserts: no overflow or overlap at all 11 viewports; touch targets at least 48 px

scenarios.title: Compact landscape collapses the controls into a menu
scenarios.asserts: compact landscape -> controls collapse into a menu; the open two-column menu keeps its button where it was tapped
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. UX review: the FAB menu aligned to the inline end moved its button 300 px when the menu wrapped (--hcm-fab-menu-align in packages/ui/src/components/fab-menu.ts).

scenarios.title: The compact bottom sheet's handle changes its height by tap, drag and keys
scenarios.asserts: tap cycles peek -> half -> full; ArrowUp and ArrowDown step one height; a drag snaps to the nearest height; the map stays visible above it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. ui-kit: hcm-sheet detents (packages/ui/src/components/sheet.ts; unit tests in packages/ui/test/components/sheet.test.ts).

scenarios.title: Dragging the bottom sheet below its lowest height closes it
scenarios.asserts: a drag below half the peek height closes the sheet and the focus returns to the control that opened it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. ui-kit: hcm-sheet settleDetent and focus return.

scenarios.title: Long Romanian labels in About wrap inside their choice instead of scrolling the dialog sideways
scenarios.asserts: at 320 and 360 px the full-screen About dialog has no horizontal scroll and its theme choice shows no icon beside the labels (only the check mark); at 1440 px no language or theme label wraps
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. Integrator, found in the M1 review screenshots: hcm-segmented-button segments are content-sized and wrap in a narrow container (packages/ui/src/components/segmented-button.ts; unit tests in packages/ui/test/components/segmented-button.test.ts and packages/ui/test/viewer/hcm-about-dialog.test.ts).

scenarios.title: Only allowlisted hosts, no Firestore calls, one map load
scenarios.asserts: the built Bucharest site boots: map canvas inside hcm-map-viewer, hcm-ready fired, 1 map created and 1 map.load event, no request outside loopback and the mocked hosts (0 Firestore calls)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. The viewer smoke on c360 and l1440 (e2e/specs/smoke/viewer-boot.spec.ts); the firewall fixture fails it on any other host.

scenarios.title: A tile host outage shows a non-blocking toast
scenarios.asserts: tile host down -> non-blocking toast

scenarios.title: An inline script or an unknown host is refused by the page policy
scenarios.asserts: an injected inline script is refused (script-src-elem) and does not run; an image from an unknown host is refused (img-src) before any request; the console shows both CSP refusals
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. The meta CSP of the generated page (scripts/site/src/csp.ts, security review §1.8), e2e/specs/viewer/content-security-policy.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: No element writes a style attribute the page's CSP refuses
scenarios.asserts: the loading indicator, the timeline, the layers list (sliders, swatches), the POI and photo sheets, the lightbox, the photo list and About raise no CSP violation event and log none in the console
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. Integrator: the kit's styleMap bindings were replaced by cssProperties (packages/ui/src/components/css-properties.ts); the console guard of every spec catches a regression.

scenarios.title: The starter kit renders a static manifest
scenarios.asserts: static manifest renders without any backend

scenarios.title: A missing config.js shows an instructive error
scenarios.asserts: missing config.js -> instructive error for the city owner

scenarios.title: An invalid config.js shows an instructive error
scenarios.asserts: invalid config.js -> instructive error for the city owner

scenarios.title: A cityId that does not match the manifest is reported to the city owner
scenarios.asserts: config.js cityId differs from manifest.city.id -> instructive error naming both ids

scenarios.title: Mapbox logo and attribution are visible at every viewport
scenarios.asserts: Mapbox logo and attribution visible at every viewport

scenarios.title: Collapsed attribution on compact stays reachable
scenarios.asserts: compact collapsed attribution still reachable

scenarios.title: With a sheet, the lightbox or About open the Mapbox logo and attribution stay visible and uncovered
scenarios.asserts: tour, every state at all 11 viewports: exactly one visible Mapbox logo and one attribution, on top (Mapbox's own on the map; the viewer's legal bar below a modal sheet or the lightbox; the foot of About); the usable floating controls stay apart
scenarios.notes: M1 follow-up, delivered with M2 (the viewer fixes of the M1 reviews, docs/research/M0-handoff.md §10o). packages/ui/src/viewer/attribution.ts, viewer-legal.ts, hcm-map-attribution.ts; the tour (e2e/tour/viewer.tour.ts).

scenarios.title: A full-height sheet on a phone ends above the legal bar, which keeps the logo and the credits of a layer switched on
scenarios.asserts: 360 x 800, the Layers sheet at full height -> the sheet ends where the legal bar begins; the bar's logo and attribution are on top and Mapbox's own controls hidden; switching on the 1966 layer adds USGS (e2e) to the bar; its links are https
scenarios.notes: M1 follow-up, delivered with M2 (the viewer fixes of the M1 reviews, docs/research/M0-handoff.md §10o).

scenarios.title: Accepting consent loads analytics and sends events
scenarios.asserts: consent banner (RO/EN); accept -> GA4 loads, page_view and layer_toggle sent without PII; the page location is the origin and path only; nothing reaches Performance Monitoring

scenarios.title: No analytics request is made before consent
scenarios.asserts: no GA or Firebase request before consent (firewall)

scenarios.title: Withdrawing consent in About stops further analytics
scenarios.asserts: consent withdrawn in About -> no further analytics requests

scenarios.title: With consent, sharing logs one share event
scenarios.asserts: after Accept and a completed share or copy, the GA4 mock records one share event; a cancelled share records none
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. Integrator (engine-ui CR-17): ViewerStore.logShare (packages/engine/src/core/store.ts). Needs CR-9 (Firebase app ids in the manifest) to send anything.

scenarios.title: After My location the position in the hash never reaches Google, and nothing goes to Performance Monitoring
scenarios.asserts: after Accept and My location (the hash holds the visitor's position) every GA4 hit carries the page's origin and path only, no request carries the position, and no request reaches Performance Monitoring (firebaselogging)
scenarios.notes: M1 follow-up, delivered with M2 (the viewer fixes of the M1 reviews, docs/research/M0-handoff.md §10o). docs/research/DECISIONS-for-review.md §18a: Performance Monitoring is out of the public viewer.

scenarios.title: Withdrawing consent expires GA4's cookies and leaves the site's own
scenarios.asserts: Accept -> the GA4 stand-in writes _ga and the container cookie; withdrawing in About -> both expired, a site cookie kept, none back after a reload
scenarios.notes: M1 follow-up, delivered with M2 (the viewer fixes of the M1 reviews, docs/research/M0-handoff.md §10o). docs/research/DECISIONS-for-review.md §18c; packages/engine/src/telemetry/cookies.ts.

scenarios.title: Declining at the banner never touches a cookie the viewer did not write
scenarios.asserts: a page's own _ga cookie survives Decline unchanged; no analytics request is made
scenarios.notes: M1 follow-up, delivered with M2 (the viewer fixes of the M1 reviews, docs/research/M0-handoff.md §10o). Only a withdrawal (granted, then denied) expires cookies: an embedding page may run its own GA4.

scenarios.title: An uncaught error is reported to telemetry.reportError
scenarios.asserts: uncaught error -> redacted report sent to telemetry.reportError (mocked)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1 against the e2e telemetry endpoint of the mock APIs (analytics.errorEndpoint); the telemetry.reportError function and Cloud Error Reporting join in M2 (functions tier).

scenarios.title: A failing error reporter never breaks the viewer
scenarios.asserts: reporter endpoint 5xx -> no visible error, viewer keeps working
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1 against the e2e telemetry endpoint of the mock APIs (analytics.errorEndpoint); the telemetry.reportError function and Cloud Error Reporting join in M2 (functions tier).

scenarios.title: Repeated errors are rate-limited
scenarios.asserts: error storm -> reports capped by the rate limit
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1 against the e2e telemetry endpoint of the mock APIs (analytics.errorEndpoint); the telemetry.reportError function and Cloud Error Reporting join in M2 (functions tier).

scenarios.title: A crash report never carries the Mapbox token
scenarios.asserts: a crash whose message holds a tile URL with access_token reaches the mock endpoint without the query string

scenarios.title: The JavaScript API mounts the viewer and drives it
scenarios.asserts: HistoricCityMap.mount(el, config) -> ready; setYear, toggleLayer, openPhoto, setLang change what is shown and fire hcm-layer-change / hcm-photo-open; the hash follows
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. Contract: docs/ENGINE_API.md -> JavaScript API.

scenarios.title: Auto-boot with a container selector that matches nothing reports it
scenarios.asserts: config.js container "#nope" -> nothing rendered, the console log names error.config.container; no map load

scenarios.title: Calls after destroy do nothing and the map is gone
scenarios.asserts: controller.destroy() -> map removed (map-instance counter back to 0); later setYear/openPhoto throw nothing and change nothing
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. Contract: docs/ENGINE_API.md -> JavaScript API.

scenarios.title: Dragging a historical layer's opacity slider fades it live
scenarios.asserts: Layers panel slider of the fixture raster at 30 % -> pixel probe blends 30 % of the layer over the basemap while dragging, before release; slider aria-valuenow 30 and aria-valuetext 30 %; the live region announces the new opacity
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: The photos opacity slider fades the camera icons and the view cones together
scenarios.asserts: photos slider at 50 % -> pixel probes at a camera icon and inside a view cone show half the contrast against the basemap; other overlays unchanged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: A POI category slider fades only that category's icons, lines and fills
scenarios.asserts: Vanished buildings slider at 20 % -> the point icon and the block fill fade (pixel probes); the vanished street line of another category keeps its opacity
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: Keyboard input past either end keeps the opacity within 0 to 100 %
scenarios.asserts: End then ArrowRight -> 100 %; Home then ArrowLeft -> 0 %, the overlay is invisible but stays listed and switched on; PageUp/PageDown move by 10; no console error
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: Moving the slider of a hidden overlay does not show it
scenarios.asserts: overlay switched off, slider moved to 60 % -> nothing drawn (pixel probe); switching it on shows it at 60 %
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: Overlay opacities survive a reload through the URL hash
scenarios.asserts: raster 40 %, photos 70 %, Vanished buildings 20 % -> the hash carries op=<layer>:40,photos:70,cladiri:20; after reload the pixel probes and the sliders show the same values; untouched overlays are not in the hash
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3; replaces S-V05-HAPPY-OVERLAY-HASH. Contract: docs/ENGINE_API.md -> URL hash v1.

scenarios.title: Out-of-range overlay opacities in the hash are clamped
scenarios.asserts: #...&op=<layer>:150,photos:-20 -> layer drawn at 100 % and photos at 0 % (pixel probes, slider values); the hash is rewritten with the clamped values
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Contract: docs/ENGINE_API.md -> URL hash v1.

scenarios.title: Unknown or malformed overlay entries in the hash are ignored
scenarios.asserts: op=<unknown id>:50, op=cladiri:abc and op=photos:10:5 -> ignored; every overlay keeps its manifest opacity; the rewritten hash leaves them out
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3; replaces S-V05-BAD-UNKNOWN-OVERLAY. Contract: docs/ENGINE_API.md -> URL hash v1.

scenarios.title: POIs render in their category colours and open their details in the photo sheet
scenarios.asserts: fixture POIs drawn as an icon, a line and a filled block in the category colours (pixel probes), labels from zoom 16; clicking one opens the same sheet as photos with title, category, years, the Markdown description, links and the linked photo thumbnails, and a thumbnail opens that photo
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: The timeline filters POIs by their years
scenarios.asserts: today -> all four fixture POIs; a stop at 1890 -> the block (from 1900) disappears; a stop at 1990 -> only the event without years remains (pixel probes, map features)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: Markup in a POI description is shown as text
scenarios.asserts: the description containing an HTML bold tag shows the tag characters as text; no element is created from it; only https links are rendered, with rel noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: A manifest with an invalid POI is refused with a localized error
scenarios.asserts: an unclosed polygon ring or a POI in an unknown category -> error card error.manifest.invalid with the issue path and validation.ringClosed / validation.reference in RO and EN; no blank map
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: A manifest without POIs shows no places and no error
scenarios.asserts: the Bucharest seed manifest (no pois, no poiCategories) -> no Places group in the Layers panel, no POI map layers, no console error
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: A category icon the engine does not bundle is drawn as the default pin
scenarios.asserts: category icon celebration -> its POI is drawn with the location_on pin; no missing-image warning from the map
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: An icon font that arrives after the map settled still draws the POI glyphs
scenarios.asserts: the icon font request is held until the map is idle -> the POI shows its category disc without a glyph; once the font arrives the white glyph appears with no camera move or other interaction (pixel probes)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. Found by the M1 final-gate screenshots (1280x800 dark: two POIs without their glyphs): Map.updateImage does not repaint an idle Mapbox map, so ensureIcon (packages/engine/src/map/icons.ts) triggers the repaint.

scenarios.title: A layer's stored image adjustments are applied on load
scenarios.asserts: a pixel probe on the layer is brighter and greyer than the raw tile colour, as its adjustments say
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. engine-core CR-11: setLayerPaint with rasterAdjustmentPaint (packages/engine/src/map/rasters.ts).

scenarios.title: Crossed brightness bounds are refused, so the image is never drawn inverted
scenarios.asserts: a manifest whose brightness minimum is above its maximum is refused (error card naming layers[0].adjustments.brightnessMax and validation.value); no inverted image is drawn
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. engine-core CR-11: rasterAdjustmentPaint of @hcm/shared clamps the admin's live sliders (unit-tested); that preview's e2e row joins the admin in M2.

scenarios.title: Google's consent stand-in issues a token that the fake Google APIs honour
scenarios.asserts: a popup of /__oauth/authorize lists the owner preselected and the requested read-only Cloud scope ticked -> Allow posts idToken, accessToken, scope and expiresIn from the mock APIs' origin -> tokeninfo answers the owner, the e2e OAuth client and the granted scopes in the browser's world and in the shared one the Functions emulator reaches; the consent request is recorded as allowed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. Google's OAuth is the only part of Google stood in for in the browser (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §2.6; e2e/admin/harness/consent.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: A cancelled consent tells the app and grants nothing
scenarios.asserts: Cancel on the stand-in page -> the opener receives a cancellation from the mock APIs' origin and no grant; the consent request is recorded as cancelled
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. The admin's stand-in client reads it, or a closed popup, as popup-closed-by-user (e2e/admin/harness/consent.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: The consent grants only the chosen account and the scopes left ticked
scenarios.asserts: another account chosen and one requested scope unticked -> tokeninfo of the issued token names that account and only the scopes left ticked; the request is recorded with them
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. The mechanism behind S-A27-BAD-SCOPE-DENIED and S-A27-BAD-WRONG-ACCOUNT (e2e/admin/harness/consent.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: The admin server serves the e2e build as Hosting does, with the emulators in its CSP
scenarios.asserts: the page holds the admin shell; firebase.json's headers with the CSP minus upgrade-insecure-requests and plus the emulators' and mock APIs' origins in connect-src; a deep link gets the app; /__/firebase/init.json is the demo-hcm web configuration and /runtime.json the e2e runtime; the legacy bundle's 45 records, the originals and the kit's fonts are served
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. e2e/mock-apis/admin-server.ts over scripts/site/src/admin/hosting.ts, whose unit tests prove the CSP is the only header that differs (e2e/admin/harness/world.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: A Google host that no fake answers stays blocked in the admin projects
scenarios.asserts: a fetch of a Firestore URL from the admin's origin fails in the page; the firewall records the URL and the console guard the blocked load
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. The admin projects forward the fake upstreams' hosts only, so the admin never reaches real Firestore or any Google API without a fake (e2e/admin/harness/world.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: A persona's storage state is a Firebase Auth session the Auth emulator accepts
scenarios.asserts: with the admin persona, the admin origin's IndexedDB holds Firebase Auth's user record for that account, and the Auth emulator's accounts:lookup with its ID token answers the same uid and address
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. The signed-in fixtures of the admin tier (owner, invited admin, editor, stranger) are storage states with IndexedDB (e2e/admin/support/session.ts; e2e/admin/harness/world.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: The seeded owner, invitation and admin are what admin.session answers
scenarios.asserts: with mapOwner owner, invited admin and admins editor: admin.session on the Functions emulator answers the owner as admin with role owner and the claim, the invited persona as not an admin with an invitation pending, the editor as admin with role admin and the claim, and the stranger as neither, with the map claimed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. The seeds of the admin tier (setup/owner, invites/{sha256 of the address}, admins/{uid} and the admin claim) match what the callables leave (e2e/admin/support/emulators.ts; e2e/admin/harness/world.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: Without a persona the admin opens signed out
scenarios.asserts: no persona -> no Firebase Auth user record in the admin origin's IndexedDB

scenarios.title: A hidden server is unreachable until it is shown again
scenarios.asserts: while hidden, a call of admin-session from the admin's origin fails like an unreachable host (the console line claimed); shown again, the anonymous call is refused 401 by the callable's access rule, which the console guard of the admin tier expects
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. 'Not deployed yet' at the network edge for the bootstrap specs (e2e/admin/support/deployment.ts; e2e/admin/harness/world.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: The project owner claims the map with Google and reaches the dashboard
scenarios.asserts: verified Google account signs in through the consent stand-in (no Cloud scope) -> admin.session says unclaimed -> the claim panel naming the project -> Confirm with Google (one click, one read-only consent: cloud-platform.read-only) -> admin.claim on the Functions emulator: tokeninfo of the caller's own token, testIamPermissions grants resourcemanager.projects.setIamPolicy on the mock Resource Manager -> admins/{uid} role owner, setup/owner and the admin claim -> the Setup Assistant open at billing; at most 2 inputs and 2 consents; no e-mail address is configured or sent besides the ID token
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6); M2b smoke of the admin tier, normal mode (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §1.3, §2.1, §3.3 d2; e2e/admin/specs/smoke.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: A non-admin without an invitation is told and signed out
scenarios.asserts: a verified Google account signed in, the map already claimed, no invitation -> admin.session -> adminShell.auth.notAdmin in the page language with Use another Google account -> signed out: the sign-in button again; no admins document for the account
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6); the notAdmin state of docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §1.3, with the stranger's storage state (e2e/admin/specs/smoke.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: Closing the sign-in popup offers Retry
scenarios.asserts: popup closed (sign-in or the claim consent) -> nothing claimed, Retry offered

scenarios.title: A delayed claim is picked up by a token refresh
scenarios.asserts: admins/{uid} exists but the ID token has no admin claim yet -> admin.session answers refreshToken -> the app refreshes the token once and opens the dashboard

scenarios.title: A Google account that does not own the project cannot claim it
scenarios.asserts: testIamPermissions grants nothing -> apiError.claim.notOwner naming the project id; no admins document, no claim

scenarios.title: An access token of another account or app is refused
scenarios.asserts: tokeninfo names another e-mail address or another OAuth client -> apiError.claim.tokenMismatch; Resource Manager is never called with it; the token appears in no log line

scenarios.title: A second owner claim is refused once the map has an owner
scenarios.asserts: an owner exists -> apiError.claim.alreadyClaimed for another account (the owner's own repeat claim succeeds unchanged); the first owner keeps the role

scenarios.title: An invited Google account joins as admin
scenarios.asserts: admins.invite stores invites/{sha256 of the lowercase address} and returns the admin link -> the invitee signs in with Google -> admin.session shows the pending invitation -> admin.join -> admins/{uid} role admin, admin claim, invitation deleted -> dashboard

scenarios.title: An invalid email is rejected
scenarios.asserts: invalid address -> validation.format on the e-mail field, before and after the call (inviteRequestSchema in the page and in admins.invite)

scenarios.title: A revoked admin loses access
scenarios.asserts: admins.revoke -> admins/{uid} deleted, claim removed, sessions revoked -> the revoked admin is denied on the next action and listed no more

scenarios.title: The owner cannot be revoked
scenarios.asserts: revoking the owner -> apiError.revoke.owner; the owner keeps the role

scenarios.title: An admin cannot remove themselves, so the map always keeps an admin
scenarios.asserts: revoking oneself -> apiError.revoke.self; with the owner never revocable the map always keeps at least one admin

scenarios.title: An expired invitation cannot be used
scenarios.asserts: the clock passes expiresAt (14 days) -> admin.join answers apiError.invite.expired; no admins document; ops.tick deletes the invitation
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/admin/join.test.ts (admin.join refuses it) and functions/test/ops/accounts.test.ts (ops.tick deletes it).

scenarios.title: Signing in with an address that was not invited does not join
scenarios.asserts: the invitee signs in with another Google account -> no pending invitation -> apiError.invite.notFound and sign-out; the invitation stays pending

scenarios.title: An invitation stores no e-mail address
scenarios.asserts: after admins.invite the invitation document holds role, invitedBy and its times only, and the address is in no Firestore document, response or log line

scenarios.title: The Setup Assistant shows every area with its status and can re-check it
scenarios.asserts: setup.status -> billing, provision, Mapbox, USGS, analytics and crash cards with their state chips and reasons; Re-check runs setup.selfTest and updates each chip; ready once billing, provision, Mapbox and USGS are ok

scenarios.title: A partial setup opens at the first incomplete step
scenarios.asserts: partial setup/status -> the page opens at the first area that is not ok

scenarios.title: A failing self-test check names what to fix
scenarios.asserts: the mock Secret Manager refuses access -> the secrets check is invalid with apiError.secrets.unavailable and a link to Provision cloud; every other check still runs and shows its own state

scenarios.title: setup.status returns health fields only
scenarios.asserts: a setup/status document that also holds an unexpected field -> setup.status answers only the fields of setupStatusViewSchema (the stray field never leaves the function)

scenarios.title: A USGS role still pending is checked again six hours later
scenarios.asserts: setup/status usgs pending with nextCheckAt passed and permissions without download -> ops.tick keeps it pending with the reason apiError.usgs.accessPending, checkedAt now and nextCheckAt six hours later
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/ops/services.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Billing and the budget are detected and recorded
scenarios.asserts: one open billing account -> one click (Link billing and create the budget) and one cloud-billing consent -> billingInfo linked (Blaze) and the budget created (5 in a USD account, its BUDGET_AMOUNTS equivalent in another currency) with 50, 90 and 100 percent and forecast thresholds -> card green; after the claim setup.recordCloud stores billing ok with the budget id

scenarios.title: Billing not enabled shows the deep link and cost explainer
scenarios.asserts: no open billing account -> the explanation and the verified deep link to Google's billing page; the card lists the accounts every 10 s and links the new one by itself once the mock shows it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6), refined in M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: An API permission error shows an actionable message
scenarios.asserts: a 403 from a Google API -> apiError.cloud.permission or apiError.cloud.apiDisabled naming the role or service

scenarios.title: Provision cloud creates what is missing and the doctor shows each item
scenarios.asserts: Prepare the project (one click, one cloud-platform consent) against the mock Google APIs -> every doctor item observed and created once in order (APIs, service accounts, roles, buckets, CORS, lifecycle, secrets, budget topic, workload identity with the numeric ids of infra/project.json, App Check, crash alerts, API key) -> a second run writes nothing; the scheduler item stays pending until the deploy

scenarios.title: An organisation policy that blocks public access is reported with its fix
scenarios.asserts: the mock org policy forbids allUsers -> the public bucket item is invalid with the fallback named; every other item still provisioned

scenarios.title: Several open billing accounts are offered as a choice
scenarios.asserts: two open accounts -> a choice with the first preselected (one more input) -> the chosen account is linked and the budget created on it

scenarios.title: A billing account at its project quota is explained
scenarios.asserts: linking refused with the billing quota error -> adminSetup.billing.quota; billing stays as it was; Retry

scenarios.title: An existing budget of the app is updated, not duplicated
scenarios.asserts: a budget with the app's name exists -> it is patched to the spec; the mock still lists one budget

scenarios.title: A missing billing role for the budget names the role
scenarios.asserts: billing linked but budget creation answers 403 -> apiError.cloud.permission naming roles/billing.costsManager; billing stays linked; Retry creates only the budget

scenarios.title: A provisioning item that fails does not stop the others
scenarios.asserts: Secret Manager answers 503 -> the secrets item and the roles that need the secrets show unavailable, every other item ok -> Retry what failed (one click) touches only those items and turns them ok
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: A Google token that expires during provisioning resumes with one consent
scenarios.asserts: the access token expires mid-run (clock) -> the run stops with the remaining items pending and Continue -> Continue (one click, one consent) finishes without repeating done items

scenarios.title: A Mapbox account with a card on file shows green
scenarios.asserts: an account out of the demo plan: the pasted secret token mints the public tokens (proof of a card on file) -> the plan step is green

scenarios.title: A trial or demo account leads to the payment step
scenarios.asserts: a demo account: Mapbox refuses to create tokens (mock 403 on POST tokens) -> apiError.mapbox.mintRefused with the link to add a payment method; nothing stored in the city; after the owner adds a card on Mapbox's page the same token pasted again turns the card green
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: A missing billing address shows a message
scenarios.asserts: an account blocked on 'confirm billing information' (mock 422 on token creation) -> apiError.mapbox.mintRefused and the billing link; the secret token is not kept

scenarios.title: A valid secret token is saved and public tokens are auto-minted within the input budget
scenarios.asserts: valid sk -> TokenValid (sk, user) -> its scopes listed -> secret stored, tiles token minted, the viewer token (the site origin) and the admin token (web.app, firebaseapp.com) minted URL-restricted -> city mapbox.publicToken written, manifest queued -> green; input budget at most 2; the secret appears in no response, document or log line
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: Missing scopes are listed with a pre-filled link
scenarios.asserts: missing scopes -> apiError.mapbox.missingScopes listing them by name, plus the token page link; nothing stored

scenarios.title: A pasted public token is explained
scenarios.asserts: pk pasted -> apiError.mapbox.publicToken explained in the page before any call (classifyMapboxToken)

scenarios.title: A revoked token is reported
scenarios.asserts: revoked token (401) -> apiError.mapbox.tokenInvalid; Mapbox chip invalid

scenarios.title: A Mapbox server error offers retry
scenarios.asserts: Mapbox 5xx -> apiError.mapbox.unavailable with Retry; nothing half-saved

scenarios.title: Rotating the viewer token publishes the new one and retires the old
scenarios.asserts: setup.rotatePublicToken -> a new URL-restricted token in the city and the next manifest -> ops.tick deletes the old token 10 minutes later (clock)

scenarios.title: Saving the token again updates the minted tokens instead of adding more
scenarios.asserts: a second setup.saveMapbox -> the existing viewer, admin and tiles token ids are updated; the mock lists as many tokens as before

scenarios.title: A replaced public token is deleted once its retirement time passes
scenarios.asserts: setup/status mapbox retiring entries past retireAt -> ops.tick deletes those tokens at Mapbox and removes them from the list; entries not yet due stay
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/ops/services.test.ts (the functions half of S-A06-HAPPY-ROTATE).

scenarios.title: A valid token with an approved role shows green
scenarios.asserts: login-token ok and permissions include download -> username and token in Secret Manager only, logout called -> green with the download role

scenarios.title: An HTML 403 means a bad token
scenarios.asserts: HTML 403 from login-token -> apiError.usgs.credentials; nothing stored

scenarios.title: A pending role auto-polls and flips green on approval
scenarios.asserts: permissions without download -> pending, apiError.usgs.accessPending with the next check; USGS approves on the mock, the check comes due (the server's clock cannot move, so setup/status.usgs.nextCheckAt does) and ops.tick, run by the e2e world, records the download role -> after a reload the card is green
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: USGS maintenance shows a banner
scenarios.asserts: HTML 503 Application Offline -> apiError.usgs.maintenance banner; the chip is unavailable and ops.tick retries

scenarios.title: A USGS token close to its expiry shows a reminder
scenarios.asserts: saved with an expiry 10 days ahead (clock) -> the USGS card shows the date and the link to create a new token

scenarios.title: The USGS paste box opens before the token page, with a 60-second countdown
scenarios.asserts: Open the USGS token page -> the paste box is open and focused before the ERS tab opens and a 60 s countdown runs -> pasting with the username filled saves at once (no Save click); input budget 3
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: A countdown that ends with nothing pasted asks for a new token
scenarios.asserts: 60 s pass (clock) with nothing pasted -> adminSetup.usgs.expired; the box stays open and the button starts again; nothing sent

scenarios.title: Multi-file drop prefills from EXIF and produces thumbnails
scenarios.asserts: multi-file drop; EXIF prefills location, date and bearing; thumbnails appear (onUpload)

scenarios.title: A photo without EXIF is placed manually
scenarios.asserts: no EXIF -> manual placement

scenarios.title: A duplicate photo is flagged
scenarios.asserts: duplicate sha256 -> flagged

scenarios.title: HEIC or PDF uploads show an error
scenarios.asserts: HEIC or PDF -> error

scenarios.title: An oversized upload is rejected with a message
scenarios.asserts: over size -> rules reject with a message

scenarios.title: An upload becomes a private original, two public WebP files and suggestions
scenarios.asserts: a JPEG uploaded under its photo document -> processing done, the original under originals/, web and thumb WebP without metadata in the public bucket, EXIF position, direction and date as suggestions, the upload deleted
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/photos/upload.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An SVG or a PDF named like a photo is refused by its bytes
scenarios.asserts: the magic bytes are not JPEG, PNG, WebP or TIFF -> processing failed with apiError.photo.unsupportedType; nothing written to either bucket
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/photos/upload.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An HEIC photo is refused with a message
scenarios.asserts: an HEIC file -> processing failed with apiError.photo.heicUnsupported, whose message says how to export a JPEG; nothing written to either bucket (DECISIONS-for-review.md §20b)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/photos/upload.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An image over 200 megapixels is refused from its header alone
scenarios.asserts: a 240-megapixel PNG header -> processing failed with apiError.photo.tooLarge; the pixels are never decoded
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/photos/upload.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The same file as another photo is flagged as its duplicate
scenarios.asserts: the upload's SHA-256 equals another photo's original -> processing failed with apiError.photo.duplicate and duplicateOf naming that photo; nothing public written
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/photos/upload.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A Storage outage keeps the upload so Reprocess can retry it
scenarios.asserts: the bucket unavailable during processing -> processing failed with a retryable error and the upload kept; photos.reprocess processes the kept upload again
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/photos/upload.test.ts and functions/test/photos/reprocess.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Editing marker, bearing and FOV with title and translation suggestions
scenarios.asserts: drag marker and bearing handle, FOV slider; title suggestion (Nominatim); translation draft (AI)

scenarios.title: A Nominatim rate limit falls back to manual entry
scenarios.asserts: Nominatim 429 -> manual entry

scenarios.title: An unavailable AI produces no draft and nothing is auto-published
scenarios.asserts: AI unavailable -> no draft, never auto-published

scenarios.title: Bulk publish rebuilds the manifest and the viewer shows the photo
scenarios.asserts: bulk publish -> manifest rebuilt -> viewer shows the photo (cross-app)

scenarios.title: Unpublishing hides the photo in the viewer
scenarios.asserts: unpublish -> hidden

scenarios.title: A photo without an English title cannot be published
scenarios.asserts: missing EN title -> blocked

scenarios.title: Publishing rebuilds the manifest with every published document
scenarios.asserts: a build task -> manifest.json gzip in the public bucket with a 60-second cache; manifests/{city} records builtVersion, url, sha256, bytes and counts

scenarios.title: A document the manifest refuses is skipped and listed
scenarios.asserts: one published document fails its manifest schema -> the manifest is published without it and manifests/{city}.skipped names it with its first issue

scenarios.title: A city without its public token keeps the last good manifest
scenarios.asserts: no viewer token on the city -> status failed with apiError.mapbox.notConfigured; the last good url, sha256, counts and builtVersion stay; nothing uploaded

scenarios.title: A change during a build queues the next build
scenarios.asserts: requestedVersion moves on while a build runs -> the build records the version it started from and queues another build task

scenarios.title: A change the manifest does not carry requests no build
scenarios.asserts: a write to an unpublished document, or of the stamp and suggestions only -> no manifests/{city} change and no task
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/publish/fields.test.ts and functions/test/publish/on-write.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Ranked scenes with footprints and browse previews
scenarios.asserts: ranked scenes, footprints, browse previews (Storage copies)

scenarios.title: Zero results show guidance
scenarios.asserts: zero results -> guidance

scenarios.title: An M2M error shows an actionable message
scenarios.asserts: M2M error -> actionable message

scenarios.title: Without USGS setup a link to setup is shown
scenarios.asserts: USGS not set up -> link to setup

scenarios.title: A free scene imports to a draft, is approved and appears in the viewer
scenarios.asserts: queued -> steps -> draft with RMSE report -> approve -> viewer shows the layer

scenarios.title: A georeferencing failure offers the georeferencer
scenarios.asserts: fails at autogcp -> error and 'Open georeferencer'

scenarios.title: An import can be cancelled
scenarios.asserts: cancel -> job cancelled

scenarios.title: A failed import can be retried successfully
scenarios.asserts: retry -> succeeds

scenarios.title: Buying a scan is prepared, tracked and auto-imported when delivered
scenarios.asserts: $30 + $5 estimate, EarthExplorer deep link, guide; 'I ordered it'; 'Check now' -> available -> auto-import and notification

scenarios.title: An order never delivered goes into the reminder state
scenarios.asserts: never delivered -> reminder state

scenarios.title: An available scene cannot be marked as ordered
scenarios.asserts: marking an available scene as ordered -> prevented

scenarios.title: A georeferenced GeoTIFF goes straight to the publish path
scenarios.asserts: georeferenced GeoTIFF -> publish path

scenarios.title: A GeoTIFF without georeference opens the georeferencer
scenarios.asserts: not georeferenced -> georeferencer

scenarios.title: A non-TIFF upload shows an error
scenarios.asserts: non-TIFF -> error

scenarios.title: A large upload resumes after an interruption
scenarios.asserts: large file -> resumable upload completes after interruption

scenarios.title: A valid tileset or XYZ URL previews and saves
scenarios.asserts: valid -> preview -> save

scenarios.title: A 404 or invalid URL shows an error
scenarios.asserts: 404 or invalid URL -> error

scenarios.title: Another account's private tileset shows an error
scenarios.asserts: another account's private mapbox:// tileset -> error

scenarios.title: GCP editing updates residuals, transform and preview, and saving queues a job
scenarios.asserts: GCPs coloured by confidence; drag updates residuals; toggle a GCP; switch transform; overlay preview; save -> regeoref job

scenarios.title: Too few GCPs disable the transform
scenarios.asserts: too few GCPs -> transform disabled

scenarios.title: An RMSE over the threshold shows a warning
scenarios.asserts: RMSE over threshold -> warning

scenarios.title: A layer under the RMSE threshold is published automatically
scenarios.asserts: RMSE < X -> published automatically

scenarios.title: A layer above the RMSE threshold stays a draft
scenarios.asserts: RMSE > X -> stays draft

scenarios.title: Jobs show live progress and logs, with retry and cancel
scenarios.asserts: live progress and logs; retry and cancel

scenarios.title: A dropped stream reconnects
scenarios.asserts: stream drop -> reconnect

scenarios.title: Settings with live M3 preview publish to the viewer
scenarios.asserts: draw bounds, About RO/EN, credits, seed colour with live M3 preview, basemap -> publish -> viewer reflects it

scenarios.title: Zero-area bounds are rejected
scenarios.asserts: zero-area bounds -> validation message

scenarios.title: A low-contrast seed is auto-adjusted with a warning
scenarios.asserts: low-contrast seed -> auto-adjust warning

scenarios.title: The session refreshes its token silently
scenarios.asserts: an hour later (clock) the ID token refreshes silently and callables keep working

scenarios.title: An admin removed mid-session is denied on the next action
scenarios.asserts: admin removed mid-session -> the next Firestore read and callable are denied (apiError.notAdmin) at once, without waiting for the token to expire

scenarios.title: A deep link while signed out leads to sign-in
scenarios.asserts: deep link while signed out -> sign-in

scenarios.title: A non-Google or unverified account is refused by every callable
scenarios.asserts: an ID token with another provider or email_verified false -> apiError.accountNotAllowed from admin.session, admin.claim and admin.join

scenarios.title: A call without App Check is refused once enforcement is on
scenarios.asserts: HCM_APP_CHECK=enforce and no App Check token -> the callable is refused and the app shows apiError.appCheck with Reload

scenarios.title: An account that never became an admin is deleted after 24 hours
scenarios.asserts: Auth accounts older than 24 hours without admins/{uid} -> deleted by ops.tick; the owner, admins, invited and newer accounts stay
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/ops/accounts.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Every admin screen works in RO and EN and switching keeps form state
scenarios.asserts: every screen in RO and EN; switching language keeps form state

scenarios.title: No English-only string or raw message id leaks into Romanian screens
scenarios.asserts: leak check (tour): no EN-only string or raw message id in RO mode

scenarios.title: The measurement id is detected and crash reports are listed
scenarios.asserts: setup.analyticsConfig reads the mock Firebase Management web app config -> measurementId and the public app ids written to the city and the next manifest; telemetry.listGroups fills the Crash reports panel from the mock Error Reporting groups
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: Analytics not enabled shows the deep link
scenarios.asserts: a web app config without measurementId -> apiError.analytics.notEnabled with the deep link and explanation

scenarios.title: An unavailable Error Reporting API shows an actionable message
scenarios.asserts: Error Reporting answers 5xx -> apiError.errorReporting.unavailable with Retry; the rest of the card works

scenarios.title: A server account without the Firebase viewer role gets an actionable message
scenarios.asserts: Firebase Management answers 403 -> apiError.cloud.permission naming roles/firebase.viewer; nothing written

scenarios.title: History page views are turned off in the GA4 stream
scenarios.asserts: Turn off history page views (one click, one analytics.edit consent) -> the mock Analytics Admin stream reads pageChangesEnabled false and the card shows it checked
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: Without a GA4 stream the setting explains what to enable first
scenarios.asserts: Firebase Management lists no analytics stream -> the card asks to enable Google Analytics first (deep link); nothing patched

scenarios.title: The crash e-mail switch turns the alert policy on and off
scenarios.asserts: switching crash e-mails off (one click, one consent) -> the mock alert policy reads enabled false; on again -> true

scenarios.title: Every edit is recorded and one click restores the previous version
scenarios.asserts: editing a POI's title writes a history entry with the previous version and the editor's uid; Revert restores it, a revert entry names the restored one, and the manifest is rebuilt

scenarios.title: A version that no longer validates is not restored
scenarios.asserts: history.revert of a snapshot that fails today's schema -> apiError.history.invalidSnapshot with the number of problems; the document is unchanged

scenarios.title: The creation entry has nothing to restore
scenarios.asserts: the entry of a create offers no Revert; history.revert of it answers apiError.history.nothingToRestore

scenarios.title: No client can write or forge history
scenarios.asserts: an admin creating, changing or deleting any history entry with the Firestore SDK is denied; reading it is allowed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by firebase/rules-tests/test/history.test.ts, for each of the five audited entities.

scenarios.title: A crash report from the site reaches Cloud Error Reporting, redacted
scenarios.asserts: POST text/plain from an allowed origin -> 204; one ERROR log entry of type ReportedErrorEvent with service viewer (admin for the admin origin), the release and a report location; no query, token or e-mail address in it

scenarios.title: A report from an unknown site is refused
scenarios.asserts: Origin not among the viewer and admin origins -> 403 apiError.telemetry.origin; nothing logged

scenarios.title: An error storm is capped
scenarios.asserts: the 11th report of one client within a minute -> 429 apiError.rateLimited with Retry-After; at most the per-minute limits are logged

scenarios.title: An oversized report is refused before it is parsed
scenarios.asserts: a body over 16 KiB -> 413 apiError.telemetry.tooLarge; nothing logged

scenarios.title: A malformed report is refused
scenarios.asserts: invalid JSON, an unknown field or a page address with its hash -> 400 apiError.invalidRequest; nothing logged

scenarios.title: Before Blaze the owner signs in and sets up without any server
scenarios.asserts: the probe of admin.session gets no answer -> Sign in asks Google for read-only Cloud access with the consent note -> testIamPermissions on the mock proves ownership -> Setup in start-up mode with only the Setup destination; no Firestore, Storage or callable request after the probe
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: A Google account that does not own the project cannot start the setup
scenarios.asserts: testIamPermissions grants nothing and Cloud Functions was never enabled -> adminShell.auth.notOwner naming the project id and Sign out; nothing else called

scenarios.title: A set-up map whose server does not answer shows a retry, not the setup
scenarios.asserts: a non-owner, Cloud Functions enabled, the server not answering -> adminShell.backend.down with Try again; once the server answers Try again opens the normal sign-in flow

scenarios.title: A reload in start-up mode keeps the detected steps but no token
scenarios.asserts: reload after billing -> the steps show their state from sessionStorage, which holds no access token, e-mail address or secret; the next step asks Google again

scenarios.title: A page that needs the server opens Setup in start-up mode
scenarios.asserts: the address #/photos in start-up mode -> Setup with adminShell.route.needsBackend

scenarios.title: When the server appears the owner claims the map without a click
scenarios.asserts: the mock Cloud Functions list goes from none to every registry function ACTIVE and the server answers -> admin.claim with the in-memory token, no click -> ID token refreshed -> setup.createCity and setup.recordCloud with the start-up results -> normal mode with the full navigation, Setup opens at Mapbox
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: A partial or failed deployment is shown and nothing is claimed
scenarios.asserts: some functions missing -> the ready and total counts, no claim; one FAILED function -> adminSetup.deploy.failed naming it

scenarios.title: Without a live Google token the claim costs one click
scenarios.asserts: the page was reloaded before the server appeared -> Confirm with Google (one click, one read-only consent) -> claimed; nothing claimed before the click

scenarios.title: A refused claim is explained and leaves the account without admin rights
scenarios.asserts: admin.claim answers apiError.claim.tokenMismatch or apiError.claim.alreadyClaimed -> its message; no admins document, no claim, Retry or sign-out

scenarios.title: Each step asks Google for its own scope only
scenarios.asserts: the recorded consent requests: read-only Cloud at sign-in in start-up mode, cloud-billing at billing, cloud-platform at provisioning, analytics.edit at the GA4 setting, each with the signed-in account as login hint; daily use after the setup asks for none

scenarios.title: Every consent explains why, for how long, and Google's unverified-app screen
scenarios.asserts: before the sign-in, billing and GA4-stream popups the panel or card shows why, that the permission stays in the tab for at most an hour, and how to continue past the unverified-app screen to the auth domain, in Romanian and English (the admin-l1440-en project)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: An unticked scope stops the step before any Google call
scenarios.asserts: the scope unticked on the consent page -> adminShell.oauth.scopeDenied naming the permission; no Google API called with the token; Retry asks again

scenarios.title: A cancelled consent changes nothing
scenarios.asserts: Cancel on the consent page of a setup step -> adminShell.oauth.popupClosed; the step is as before

scenarios.title: Choosing another Google account on the consent page is refused
scenarios.asserts: another account chosen -> adminShell.oauth.wrongAccount; the token is dropped and nothing called with it

scenarios.title: A Google access token is never stored or sent elsewhere
scenarios.asserts: after every step no Google access token is found in localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, cookies or the address, nor in any request other than to Google and admin.claim

scenarios.title: One click imports the 45 legacy photos through the photo pipeline
scenarios.asserts: Import the 45 photos (one click) -> 45 photo documents with their legacyId, each original uploaded and processed by photos.onUpload, published once processed with rightsReview kept -> the manifest lists them; input budget 1
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: Importing again creates nothing new
scenarios.asserts: a second import -> no new document, no new upload; the city still has 45 legacy photos

scenarios.title: An interrupted import finishes the missing photos only
scenarios.asserts: the page closed after some uploads -> the next import uploads only the photos without an image and finishes

scenarios.title: A photo that fails processing is listed and the rest are imported
scenarios.asserts: one original fails processing -> listed with its apiError.photo reason; the other 44 are imported and published

scenarios.title: The navigation follows the window class
scenarios.asserts: compact: navigation bar with Setup, Photos, Places, Layers and More; medium and expanded: collapsed rail; large: expanded rail; the active route is marked and survives a reload

scenarios.title: An unknown address opens Setup
scenarios.asserts: an unknown or malformed hash -> Setup with adminShell.route.notFound

scenarios.title: A landscape phone gets a rail instead of the bar
scenarios.asserts: 915 x 412 (compact height) -> the collapsed rail instead of the bar; no floating control overlaps and none leaves the screen

scenarios.title: The whole Setup Assistant takes at most ten inputs and four consents
scenarios.asserts: from sign-in to the legacy import with the mocks: at most 10 in-app inputs and 4 Google consents (setupInputBudget); the human-only work on the providers' pages is not counted
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: A failed step costs one more input, never a re-entry
scenarios.asserts: a provisioning item fails, then Retry -> one more input; nothing detected is asked again

scenarios.title: A queued job produces a draft layer within tolerance
scenarios.asserts: queued job -> worker (synthetic tgz from mock M2M) -> MTS mock -> draft layer within tolerance

scenarios.title: A corrupt archive fails the job with a clear error
scenarios.asserts: corrupt archive -> job failed with CorruptArchive

scenarios.title: Missing reference coverage fails the job with a clear error
scenarios.asserts: no reference coverage -> ReferenceUnavailable

scenarios.title: An MTS job failure is retried
scenarios.asserts: MTS job failure -> retry

scenarios.title: SIGTERM cancels the job and cleans up
scenarios.asserts: SIGTERM -> status cancelled, temp files removed

scenarios.title: Re-georeferencing with manual GCPs produces a new version
scenarios.asserts: regeoref with manual GCPs -> new layer version

scenarios.title: A degenerate GCP set fails with an error
scenarios.asserts: degenerate GCP set -> error
